Hi Sophie / Camila —

Purge execution complete. Summary and proof below.

Execution summary:
- Start: 2026-10-13 09:05 PDT
- End: 2026-10-13 15:18 PDT
- Scope: Prompts, assistant outputs, request/response access logs for dataset LZ-778 across us-west-2 buckets and managed KV stores. Embedding indices were scanned; no persistent indices required deletion (only derived vectors were dropped per runbook).

Artifacts attached/uploaded:
- deletion_manifest.csv (rows: object_path, sha256_hash, deletion_timestamp)
- ops_ticket_9238.pdf (ticket export with run logs)
- deletion_evidence_20261013.txt (signed hash list) — attached and uploaded to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/LiveZone/DeletionEvidence/20261013

Proof snippet (example):
> s3://redwood-prod-us-west-2/livezone/LZ-778/prompts/778-4123.json  9f2b... 2026-10-13T12:03:21Z
> s3://redwood-prod-us-west-2/livezone/LZ-778/outputs/778-4123-out.json  a3c1... 2026-10-13T12:03:22Z

Notes and caveats:
- Prefetch/KV caches: prefix entries were invalidated and a subsequent KV compaction completed. A small number of ephemeral caches on transient instances were marked and cleared; no residual readable content remains per sampling checks.
- Audit snapshot (pre-delete metadata) retained for 90 days per our internal retention policy; content is metadata-only (no prompt/output text). If LiveZone requires a longer metadata retention hold to support their regulator, escalate to compliance@redwood.com.

If this meets LiveZone's requirements please reply ACK and we'll mark the ops ticket resolved. If you require a signed DocuSign attestation, we can generate one on request (adds 1 business day).
